payload.title: Residual sequence-state evidence beyond E011
payload.statement: Legal within-well row-sequence and typewell-consistency features may predict a bounded higher-resolution residual profile around E011 that transfers across repeated whole-well, spatial, and typewell holdouts.
payload.evidence_for: E011 residuals are extremely persistent: mean ACF is 0.999980 at lag 1 and 0.975232 at lag 64, with 98.28% mean low-frequency energy. Hidden-label 16-control and 32-control spline oracles reach 1.186785 and 0.638082 RMSE, confirming very large sequence capacity. Several legal branches gain 0.12-0.38 RMSE on repeated contexts.
payload.evidence_against: No legal branch passes the frozen final contract. block_ridge_b32 is the strongest preliminary passer at +0.285655 RMSE, 5/5 maps and 24/25 cells, but loses spatial group 4 by 0.171137. A reversed-profile negative control gains 0.132948, above the 0.03 cap, and the other passers fail spatial/typewell and/or zero-p90-deterioration gates.
payload.next_test: Closed by T023/D025. Do not start or retune a GRU, TCN, HMM/PF extension, new path bank, or the same residual-profile proxy. Revisit only with materially different causal sequence evidence or a different legal state target that defeats all negative and shift controls.
